newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: Czech CSOB lowers prime rate 50 bps to 17.5 pct.
newsitem.headline: Czech CSOB lowers prime rate 50 bps to 17.5 pct.

text.p: Prague-based Ceskoslovenska Obchodni Bank lowered on Thursday its prime lending rate 50 basis points to 17.5 percent, the bank said in a statement.

It said its base rate for credit with up to one-year maturity was lowered 100 basis points to 18 percent, while the base rate for one to two year credit was lowered to 17 percent from 18. The move continues a general easing of credit rates on the Czech market in recent days.
